description: A new Gallery Page joins the site's routes behind the Name gate. A section-capable photo manifest (typed content data artifact: sections of photos with id, alt, optional caption, intrinsic dimensions) drives a server-rendered grid — justified rows on desktop collapsing to a uniform two-column grid on mobile via react-photo-album's server component, shipping zero client JavaScript. Every tile reserves its aspect ratio from the manifest (zero CLS); below-the-fold images lazy-load; tiles keep an edge gutter (iOS edge-swipe guard). A single section renders with no section headers. The primary nav gains Gallery between Travel and Registry. Ships with an initial subset of the supplied photos so the page is demoable; the full curated set lands in the launch content pass.
title: Gallery Page walks: gated route, nav entry, zero-JS photo grid
acceptance_criteria: The Gallery route renders the grid from the photo manifest behind the Name gate, justified rows on desktop and two columns on mobile
The route ships zero client JavaScript for the grid (lightbox excluded, it is a later slice)
No cumulative layout shift: every tile reserves space from intrinsic dimensions before images load
With one section in the manifest, no section headers render; adding a second named section renders headers without layout change
Nav order is Home, RSVP, Details, Travel, Gallery, Registry, FAQs in desktop list and mobile drawer
All color and font values come from Theme tokens
